component.name: YestreamScene
component.script:
sub init() m.topNav = m.top.findNode("topNav") m.homeScreen = m.top.findNode("homeScreen") m.liveTvScreen = m.top.findNode("liveTvScreen") m.movieScreen = m.top.findNode("movieScreen") m.seriesScreen = m.top.findNode("seriesScreen") m.epgScreen = m.top.findNode("epgScreen") m.playlistsScreen = m.top.findNode("playlistsScreen") m.settingsScreen = m.top.findNode("settingsScreen") m.expiryLockScreen = m.top.findNode("expiryLockScreen")
m.topNav.observeField("activeTabIndex", "onTabChanged") m.homeScreen.observeField("selectedAction", "onHomeAction") m.expiryLockScreen.observeField("selectedAction", "onExpiryAction")
' Observe back events from sub-screens m.movieScreen.observeField("onBack", "onSubScreenBack") m.seriesScreen.observeField("onBack", "onSubScreenBack") m.epgScreen.observeField("onBack", "onSubScreenBack") m.settingsScreen.observeField("onBack", "onSubScreenBack")
initializeDevice() end sub
sub initializeDevice() identity = loadStoredIdentity() m.top.deviceId = getDeviceId() m.top.macAddress = identity.mac m.top.deviceKey = identity.key6
' Set device info on HomeScreen m.homeScreen.macAddress = identity.mac m.homeScreen.planText = "● ACTIVE • TRIAL • Yestream Cloud" m.homeScreen.callFunc("updateDeviceInfo")
' Register device with backend payload = { mac: identity.mac, hardwareFingerprint: m.top.deviceId, platform: "Roku", model: CreateObject("roDeviceInfo").GetModel(), appVersion: "0.1.0" }
regRes = registerDevice(payload) if regRes.ok and regRes.data <> invalid if regRes.data.credential <> invalid identity.credential = regRes.data.credential saveStoredIdentity(identity) end if
' Check if subscription is expired status = regRes.data.status plan = regRes.data.plan if status = "expired" or status = "suspended" m.expiryLockScreen.visible = true m.expiryLockScreen.setFocus(true) else m.expiryLockScreen.visible = false m.homeScreen.planText = "● ACTIVE • " + UCase(plan ? plan : "PRO") + " • Active Subscription" m.homeScreen.callFunc("updateDeviceInfo") m.homeScreen.setFocus(true) end if else m.homeScreen.setFocus(true) end if end sub
sub onTabChanged() idx = m.topNav.activeTabIndex m.homeScreen.visible = (idx = 0) m.liveTvScreen.visible = (idx = 1) m.movieScreen.visible = (idx = 2) m.seriesScreen.visible = (idx = 3) m.epgScreen.visible = (idx = 4) m.playlistsScreen.visible = (idx = 5) m.settingsScreen.visible = (idx = 6)
if idx = 0 m.homeScreen.setFocus(true) else if idx = 1 m.liveTvScreen.setFocus(true) else if idx = 2 m.movieScreen.setFocus(true) else if idx = 3 m.seriesScreen.setFocus(true) else if idx = 4 m.epgScreen.setFocus(true) else if idx = 5 m.playlistsScreen.setFocus(true) else if idx = 6 m.settingsScreen.setFocus(true) end if end sub
sub onHomeAction() action = m.homeScreen.selectedAction if action = "liveTV" m.topNav.callFunc("setFocusToTab", 1) m.topNav.activeTabIndex = 1 else if action = "movies" m.topNav.callFunc("setFocusToTab", 2) m.topNav.activeTabIndex = 2 else if action = "series" m.topNav.callFunc("setFocusToTab", 3) m.topNav.activeTabIndex = 3 else if action = "epg" m.topNav.callFunc("setFocusToTab", 4) m.topNav.activeTabIndex = 4 else if action = "playlists" m.topNav.callFunc("setFocusToTab", 5) m.topNav.activeTabIndex = 5 else if action = "settings" m.topNav.callFunc("setFocusToTab", 6) m.topNav.activeTabIndex = 6 else if action = "refresh" initializeDevice() else if action = "focusNav" m.topNav.callFunc("setFocusToTab", 0) end if end sub
sub onSubScreenBack() ' Return to Home m.topNav.callFunc("setFocusToTab", 0) m.topNav.activeTabIndex = 0 end sub
sub onExpiryAction() action = m.expiryLockScreen.selectedAction if action = "refresh" initializeDevice() else if action = "playlists" m.expiryLockScreen.visible = false m.topNav.callFunc("setFocusToTab", 5) m.topNav.activeTabIndex = 5 end if end sub
